messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: prod-us-east /v1/generate p95 > 10s for 5m window. pool=batcher-gpu-pool-3. 5xx rate up ~4%. Paging @oncall @sre-lead @marta

marta: ack, seeing the alert. I'll join.

lee: on it, pulling traces and qlen.

marta: quick context — we rolled rwd-7b-q4 yesterday and traffic shape changed; long sequence churn from acme-inc looks suspicious.

lee: metrics: continuous-batching queue length spiking, avg wait ~280ms. batching.window_ms currently 60ms, target_batch_size 128.

alex: two immediate mitigations: increase window_ms -> bigger batches -> fewer kernel toggles (helps throughput/5xx) but increases tail latency; OR decrease window_ms -> reduce latency but increase per-token GPU ops (may saturate).

sre-lead: what's customer impact? are real users timing out?

marta: acme-inc saw client timeouts and retries, causing amplification. Some other tenants see higher p95 but not timeouts.

sam: we can also soft-throttle noisy tenants as a fast safety valve. Recommend acme-inc concurrency 40 -> 10 for 10m.

lee: proposing combined mitigation: 1) soft quota on acme-inc, 2) reduce batching.window_ms to 20ms for primary pool, 3) disable continuous prefetch temporarily. This should cut p95 quickly while we stabilise.

alex: commands ready to run:

```
redwoodctl config patch --pool batcher-gpu-pool-3 --set 'batching.window_ms=20'
redwoodctl quota set acme-inc --concurrency 10 --duration 10m --reason 'live mitigation: noisy tenant'
redwoodctl feature toggle --pool batcher-gpu-pool-3 --feature continuous_prefetch --state off
```

lee: applying quota now.

oncall-bot: action: quota change applied for acme-inc by lee at 2310456792

lee: quota applied. patching batching.window_ms -> 20ms now.

infra-bot: config rollout triggered for batcher-gpu-pool-3 (3 nodes) — hot patch if supported, else rolling restart.

marta: note: if rollout does a restart we may see short 502s. Can we hot-patch without restarts?

alex: runtime supports dynamic patch for window_ms. doing hot patch.

alex: hot patch complete. batching.window_ms=20 on pool. Observing p95 drop 8.9s -> ~1.6s within 90s.

lee: error rate down to 0.8%. GPU util +12%.

sam: keeping acme-inc quota for 10m. Also applying traffic-shaping: burst_tokens/customer 200 -> 80.

marta: updating runbook with decisions & owners. If p95 climbs >3s we revert.

sre-lead: assigning postmortem to @marta. Capture timeline, root cause (noisy long-seq tenant + batch parameter mismatch), mitigations, and follow-ups (adaptive per-tenant batching, auto-throttle heuristics).

julie: ack, i'll take watch in 45m. please handoff status.

lee: handover note: metrics dashboard https://metrics.redwood.com/d/abc123/batcher-gpu-pool-3?orgId=1, logs: https://logs.redwood.com/q=pool%3Dbatcher-gpu-pool-3

marta: customer-ops notified acme-inc: 'we applied a temporary soft quota and reduced batch window to stabilise platform; you may see higher latency for some requests. monitoring now.' They acknowledged and asked for ETA.

marta: ETA plan: monitor 30m; if stable remove quota and re-enable continuous_prefetch after 1h. If any regression, keep prefetch off and tune max_batch_tokens -> 1024.

oncall-bot: incident severity set to sev2. Incident ID INC-20260315-0421

sre-lead: handoff to night oncall @julie at 2310456850. Julie: monitor p95, 5xx, acme-inc thread. escalate if 5xx >1% again.

julie: ack, taking over. I'll post updates here.

lee: final note before stepping off: if we re-enable prefetch and see p95 rise, prefer keeping prefetch off and adding adaptive batching per customer.

marta: thanks team. I'll draft postmortem skeleton and follow-ups.

julie: watching now.
